title: Two traders and a carton of shirts
body: A carton contains 200 shirts. Of these, 170 shirts are good, 20 shirts have minor defects and 10 shirts have major defects. Two traders inspect shirts from this carton. Ravi accepts only the shirts that are good. Meena rejects only the shirts that have major defects and accepts all the others. A shirt is drawn at random from the carton, so each of the 200 shirts is equally likely to be drawn.
